title: AI Gateway expands Kimi ZDR options
summary: Check enforcement and tool-policy scope separately.
body_markdown:
##


Trace the request path


Imagine a direct‑model request with a ZDR‑marked BYOK key, team‑wide enforcement off, and no request flag. The[guide](https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/security-and-compliance/zdr) says attestation alone does not enforce ZDR. Use team‑wide ZDR or` zeroDataRetention: true` to require it; request‑level false cannot cancel team enforcement.


With enforcement on, if marked keys fail, eligible system credentials can take over. No compliant route means failure. But provider‑executed tools may fall outside provider policies without Gateway rejecting the call. That general caveat is not a finding about a particular Kimi route. Check the tool path before treating` enabledZeroDataRetention: true` as whole‑agent non‑retention evidence. The guide separates eligibility failures (403) from unavailable compliant routes (400). Its update label is September 22; eligibility differs by enforcement mode. This is documented analysis, not a retention test.
